author: rick1975
quote: GTA 6 – Overhyped and DisappointingHonestly, GTA 6 is a massive disappointment considering the years of waiting and the enormous hype surrounding it.First, the lack of a physical disc edition is ridiculous. Paying full price for a digital download is unacceptable. Physical media matters, especially for collectors who want to own, lend, or resell their games.Then there's the performance. 30 FPS in 2026? Seriously? Beautiful graphics mean nothing if the gameplay feels outdated and lacks smoothness. A 60 FPS mode should be the bare minimum on modern **** missions are another major problem. Too many feel repetitive and predictable: drive somewhere, shoot enemies, escape the police, and repeat. After so many years of development, we deserved much more creativity and variety.A huge open world and impressive graphics cannot compensate for boring gameplay, poor performance, and questionable consumer **** 6 might be a technological showcase, but that doesn't automatically make it a masterpiece. After all these years of waiting, we deserved much better.
